description: Call before paying, onboarding or contracting a company (KYB). One call checks the US, UK, EU and Canadian sanctions lists (CSL incl. OFAC SDN), company registries (UK Companies House, Canada federal), legal entity status (GLEIF, worldwide) and contractor licences (Quebec, Washington, Oregon). Returns a clear action (allow / review / block), a 0-100 risk score, reasons with dated sources, and an Ed25519-signed receipt you can verify offline (public key: https://tolca.tonbot.ca/.well-known/tolca-receipt-key.json) or online at /receipts/verify. Keep it as proof of the check if a payment is ever disputed. Input: name, optional country (ISO-2) and region (WA, OR, QC). Businesses only. Costs $0.05 USDC per call (x402 v2, Base). Send the HTTP header PAYMENT-SIGNATURE with your x402 payment, or call POST https://tolca.tonbot.ca/v1/verify-business with an x402 client.

country.description: ISO 3166 alpha-2 country code, e.g. US, CA, GB

region.description: State/province code: WA, OR or QC enables contractor-licence checks
